Board lead: routability scales roughly linearly with area, about 0.000794 per mm². The 0.95 floor therefore sits near 1197 mm², and I'm cutting from 1250 to 1205 mm². That gives routability of about 0.957 and a volume of 2699 mm³, which frees about 101 mm³ for the interior pool. I won't go lower, because below roughly 1197 the 10-layer [SoC withheld] board doesn't route.

The interior is still over by about 1145 mm³, so I can't accept yet. The rest has to come from the other domains: battery at 3786, antenna at 1500, acoustics at 1460, and structure at 1800. I'm not asking to reopen the port or the wall.

Battery can't absorb much of the 1,145 mm³ overage. At 3786 mm³ and 800 mm², I'm at 59.78 h, already just under 60, and thickness is 4.73 mm. With the 2.24 mm board the stack is 6.97 mm, inside the 7.1 mm limit. Runtime scales at about 0.0158 h per mm³, so every 100 mm³ I give up costs about 1.6 h. It also cuts the energy available for the 3 h siren, which acoustics needs to confirm.

I'll probe 3700 and 3650 to see the runtime and siren trade-off. Cutting more than about 100 mm³ would need marketing to accept a lower runtime.

Antenna (1500), acoustics (1460) and structure (1800) need to show real cuts. The perimeter pool has 580 mm³ of slack, so antenna and NFC can be reshaped there without touching the wall or port.

Antenna: my L5 efficiency is 0.208 at 1500 mm³, which is already low, so I don't want to cut blindly. I'm probing 1300 and 1100 to find where L5 falls off, plus a thinner-wall what-if. I'm not asking to reopen the wall, but a thinner wall would also detune me less and would return interior volume to everyone (150 mm³ per 0.1 mm).

I accept that antenna has to share the 1,145 mm³ overage. Once the probes show the L5 cost per 100 mm³, I'll commit a cut next turn. The perimeter pool has 580 mm³ of slack, so I'll reshape the keepout there rather than ask for more. I'm OBJECTing for now because the interior is over.

Thermal: I'm at 43.0 °C against the 43 limit with A_spr = 320 mm² (250 mm³), so I have no margin. I can't cut volume without breaking skin temperature. I'm holding 320 and not asking for more.

The caseback is at 1120 of 1143 mm², so the spreader fits. I still OBJECT because the interior is over by 1145 mm³.

My probes check two things. One is how much temperature changes if the spreader shrinks to 300. The other is whether a larger spreader could offset a thinner wall. I'm not pushing a wall change. Those numbers will show the trade if the other leads' cuts fall short.

Structure: my margin is 1.438 at a 1.2 mm wall, a 9.0 mm² port and 1800 mm³ of ribs. That is below the 1.5 requirement, so I can't accept. I know the program wants the wall and port left alone, so I'm not asking to change either yet.

My probes test the cheapest fixes:
- More rib volume at the same wall.
- A +0.1 mm wall, which would cost everyone 150 mm³.
- A smaller port, as a what-if only.

Ribs may be the cheapest route even though they add volume, because the wall costs 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm. I'll commit next turn once I see the numbers. I can't give back volume without breaking pressure margin.

Acoustics: I OBJECT. My own requirement fails. The siren needs 9.08 W for 86 dB, against a 1.0 W limit, so endurance is only 0.34 h. The cause is a 5.6 kHz resonance with a lossy mesh, not a lack of volume, so I'm not asking for the port or wall to reopen. I'm dropping the mesh to the 20 rayl floor and lengthening the outlet to lower the resonance.

If I reach 1 W, endurance scales to about 3.1 h at 3786 mm³ of battery. That is roughly 3.0 h at 3700 mm³ and below 3 h at 3650 mm³. Battery should therefore hold at about 3700 or more.

I'll offer a volume cut once the probes show it is safe.

Haptics: I can give back volume. Force scales roughly linearly with volume, about 0.00305 N/mm³. The 0.9 N floor sits near 295 mm³. I'm cutting from 350 to 305 mm³, which gives about 0.93 N with a small margin. That frees 45 mm³ and brings the interior overage to about 1,100 mm³. I won't go lower, because 295 leaves no margin.

I'm not asking for any change to the port or wall. Antenna, acoustics, structure and battery still need to show cuts. Structure's rib fix will add volume, so those cuts matter more. I'll OBJECT until the interior balances.

NFC can give back volume. Read range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so there is slack. I'm cutting the loop from 320 to 240 mm³ and the ferrite from 180 to 140 mm³. That is 380 mm³ total, freeing 120 mm³ and bringing the overage to about 980 mm³. The loop stays far below the perimeter cap. My probes at 200/120, 180/110 and 260/150 show where range hits 10 mm. If one of them holds, I'll cut deeper next turn. I won't touch the port or wall. Antenna, structure, acoustics and battery still have to show cuts, so I OBJECT because the interior is over.

Board: routability is 0.952 at 1200 mm² and exactly 0.95 at 1197 mm², so last round's probes confirm the floor. I'm moving from 1205 to 1200 mm², which is 2688 mm³ and frees another 11 mm³. I'm keeping 3 mm² of margin above the floor, so 1197 stays unclaimed. The board is then at its minimum, and further cuts would break routing.

The interior is still over by roughly 970 mm³. That has to come from antenna, structure, acoustics and battery. I'm not asking to reopen the wall or the port. I OBJECT until the interior balances.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm² for now. Runtime is 59.78 h, already just under 60, and each 100 mm³ costs about 1.6 h (3700 mm³ gives 58.42 h). Runtime depends only on volume. The 760 mm² probe failed the 7.1 mm stack at 4.87 mm thickness, so footprint can't shrink either.

Acoustics also needs battery energy for the 3 h siren. I can give up at most about 50 mm³ (0.8 h), and only after acoustics confirms 1 W. Antenna, structure and acoustics hold 4,760 mm³ between them, and the board is already at its routing floor, so the remaining ~970 mm³ has to come mostly from them. I OBJECT because the interior is over.

Antenna: my probes show L5 is 0.208 at 1500 mm³, 0.156 at 1300 and 0.112 at 1100. Each 100 mm³ cut costs about 0.022 to 0.026 of efficiency, and there is no flat region to cut into. I'll give 100 mm³ now, going to 1400 for about 0.182. I won't go deeper without seeing everyone else's cuts.

The ledger is still about 870 mm³ over after this, and the remaining cuts are all costly. Structure is also below its 1.5 margin and needs volume, not less. I'm not reopening the wall, but I'll say plainly that thinning it would be the cheapest source of volume if the other cuts fall short.

Thermal: I'm holding A_spr at 320 mm² (250 mm³). Skin temperature is 43.0 °C against the 43 limit. Each mm² is worth about 0.012 °C, so I can't give volume back. Last round's probes show the wall barely affects me: 1.3 mm gives 43.01 °C, about +0.01 °C per 0.1 mm. Thermal is therefore neutral on any wall decision, and I won't block one. The caseback has 23 mm² spare, so I can grow the spreader if someone needs thermal margin.

The ledger is still about 870 mm³ over. The remaining cuts are small: battery about 50, antenna costly, and board and haptics at their floors. Structure also needs volume, not less. I OBJECT because the interior is over. The shortfall will probably need a program decision on wall or port, and this round's probes only check my own sensitivity to wall.

Structure: the 870 mm³ overage can't be closed by cuts alone, so I'm proposing the cheapest wall/rib trade I can find.

- **Rib cost:** 200 mm³ of ribs buys only +0.016 margin.
- **Wall value:** +0.1 mm of wall buys about +0.197 margin and costs 150 mm³.
- **Trade:** cut ribs to 1400, which saves 400 mm³ and costs about 0.03 margin. Recover that with a wall of about 1.26 mm, which costs about 90 mm³. The net saving is about 310 mm³.

I'm claiming 1400 mm³ ribs and a 1.26 mm wall, and I'

Acoustics: I still OBJECT because the siren needs 9.08 W against the 1.0 W limit. The cause is the 5.6 kHz resonance and the 40 rayl mesh, not a shortage of volume or port area. I'm keeping the 9.0 mm² port and dropping the mesh to the 20 rayl floor. I'm also lengthening the outlet to 2.0 mm to pull the resonance down.

My probes test whether I can give back volume. One uses a 3.0 mm outlet at 1300 mm³. One uses 2.0 mm at 1200 mm³. One checks 3700 mm³ of battery. I'll commit a volume cut next turn once one of them reaches 1 W. Battery should hold at least about 3700 mm³ for the 3 h siren. I can accept structure's rib-for-wall trade if the ledger balances and the port stays at 9.0.

Haptics: I'm trimming from 305 to 300 mm³. Probes show 0.916 N at 300 and 0.901 N at 295, so 300 keeps about 0.016 N of margin over the 0.9 N floor. That frees only 5 mm³ more, and I won't go lower. The last 5 mm³ isn't worth the risk to the force floor.

The ledger is still about 870 mm³ over. The haptics cut is negligible against that, so the real fix is structure's rib-for-wall trade (about 310 mm³ net) plus battery and acoustics cuts. I can accept a wall of about 1.26 mm. A thicker wall doesn't change my force. I OBJECT until the interior balances.

NFC: my probes show range is 12.7 mm at the 180/110 floor, against the 10 mm requirement. I'm moving to the bounds, V_loop 180 and V_ferr 110, which is 290 mm³ in total. That frees another 90 mm³, so the overage drops from about 864 to about 774. I'm at my minimum and can't give more.

Structure's rib-for-wall trade would save about 310 mm³ net, leaving roughly 460 mm³ over. I can live with a wall of about 1.26 mm. I can't test the wall effect on range myself, but a 2.7 mm margin should cover any detuning. Antenna, acoustics and battery still need to close the rest. I OBJECT until the interior balances.

Board: I'm moving from 1200 to 1198 mm², which is 2683.5 mm³ and frees about 4.5 mm³. Routability is 0.951 there, so I keep 0.001 of margin over the 0.95 floor. 1197 mm² passes at exactly 0.95, but I won't claim it because I don't know the evaluator's rounding. The board is at its floor, and I can't give more than a rounding error beyond this.

The interior is still about 770 mm³ over, so I OBJECT. I support structure's rib-for-wall trade, since it is the largest single saving offered so far. The board's routability doesn't depend on wall or port. Acoustics should report which 1 W probe works. Battery, antenna and acoustics need to commit cuts to close the remaining ~460 mm³.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm². The ledger is still 769 mm³ over, so I OBJECT.

- **Runtime:** 59.78 h at 3786 mm³, and it depends on volume only. 3750 mm³ gave 59.21 h, so each 100 mm³ costs about 1.6 h.
- **Footprint:** I can't shrink it because of the 7.1 mm stack. Growing A_batt to 820 mm² only thins the cell to 4.62 mm and saves no volume. The caseback would be 1140 of 1143 mm², which leaves thermal no room, so I'm keeping 800.
- **Offer:** I'll go to about 3736 mm³ (-50 mm³, about 58.9 h) once acoustics shows a 1 W siren, because the 3 h siren needs the battery energy.
- **Where the rest has to come from:** Structure's trade saves about 310 mm³. Acoustics'

Antenna: my L5 numbers are 0.181 at 1400 mm³, 0.169 at 1350 and 0.156 at 1300, so each 100 mm³ costs about 0.025. Wall sensitivity is about -0.008 per +0.1 mm, so structure's 1.26 mm wall costs me only about 0.005. I can accept it. It does reopen the wall, though, so program direction should confirm it.

I'm cutting another 50 mm³ to 1350 (L5 0.169) now. I'll go to 1300 only if the ledger is still over after acoustics commits its cut. The ledger is still about 770 mm³ over, so I OBJECT. Acoustics holds 1460 mm³ and is the largest remaining lever.

Thermal: I'm holding A_spr at 320 mm² (250 mm³). Skin temperature is 43.0 °C at the 43 limit with wall 1.2, and I'm not asking for more volume.

- **Wall:** a 1.26 mm wall would add about +0.006 °C, which puts me right at the limit. I'd then take a few extra mm² of spreader, about 4 mm³ and well inside the caseback's 23 mm² spare. My probes check this. I don't block structure's trade.
- **Ledger:** the interior is still about 719 mm³ over. Structure's trade saves about 310 mm³, which leaves roughly 410 mm³. That has to come from acoustics, which holds 1460 mm³, plus battery and antenna. Acoustics needs to commit a volume cut this turn.
- **Status:** I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance. My own requirement is met.

Structure: my margin is 1.438 at 1.2 mm wall and 1800 mm³ of ribs, so I fail the 1.5 requirement as it stands. I'm committing to the trade:

- **Ribs:** 1400 mm³, which saves 400 mm³ and costs about 0.03 margin.
- **Wall:** 1.26 mm, which costs everyone about 90 mm³ and should give about 1.52 margin.
- **Net saving:** about 310 mm³.
- **Remaining overage:** about 410 mm³.

Antenna, thermal, haptics, NFC and board have said they can live with this. This does reopen the wall, so program direction should confirm. The port stays at 9.0 mm², and I won't ask for more.

The remaining ~410 mm³ has to come mainly from acoustics, plus about 50 mm³ from battery and possibly antenna. I OBJECT until my numbers confirm the margin and the interior balances.

Acoustics: the siren still draws 7.67 W against the 1.0 W limit, so I OBJECT. The siren fails because the resonance sits at 5275 Hz, which is too high. Volume and port area aren't the cause. Cutting volume raises the resonance, as the 1300 and 1200 mm³ probes showed (5687 and 6246 Hz). Lengthening the outlet from 2.

Haptics: force is 0.916 N at 300 mm³, and my probes show 0.904 N at 296 and 0.910 N at 298. The floor is 0.9 N at about 295 mm³. I'm trimming to 298 mm³, which gives 0.910 N and frees 2 mm³. I'm keeping 0.01 N of margin, because the evaluator rounding is unknown. Anything lower saves almost nothing against a 409 mm³ overage.

I support structure's 1.26 mm wall. It doesn't change my force.

The real gap is acoustics, which holds 1460 mm³ and still has a siren at 7.67 W. Acoustics needs to commit a volume cut and a working outlet and mesh combination. Battery should give its 50 mm³, and antenna should hold at 1350 unless the ledger forces more.

My own requirement is met. I OBJECT only because the interior is still over.

NFC: I'm at my floor of 180 mm³ loop and 110 mm³ ferrite, 290 mm³ in total. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, and the 130 mm³ ferrite probe only gave 13.0 mm. More ferrite buys range I don't need, so I'm not growing. I can't cut either bound, so I have nothing more to give.

I can live with structure's 1.26 mm wall. I can't probe wall, but 2.7 mm of margin should cover any detuning. The loop is also well inside the perimeter keepout, at 1530 of 2400 mm³ claimed.

The interior is still about 407 mm³ over. The remaining lever is acoustics' 1460 mm³, plus battery's 50 mm³ and possibly antenna. I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1198 mm² (2683.5 mm³), where routability is 0.951. My probes last round gave 0.950 at both 1197.5 and 1197, so 1197.5 would only free about 1 mm³. That is not worth giving up the margin when I don't know the evaluator's rounding. The board is at its floor, and wall and port don't affect its routability.

I support structure's 1.26 mm wall and ribs trade.

The interior is still 407 mm³ over, so I OBJECT. That gap can only close from acoustics' 1460 mm³, battery's offered 50 mm³ and possibly antenna. Acoustics, please commit a volume cut and a working outlet and mesh combination for the 1 W siren this round.

Battery: I'm holding A_batt at 800 mm², since a bigger footprint saves no volume and squeezes thermal. I'm cutting V_batt now from 3786 to 3750 mm³, which gives 59.2 h and frees 36 mm³. Thickness at 3750/800 is about 4.69 mm, so the stack still fits.

I'll go to 3736 mm³ (about 58.9 h) once acoustics shows a 1 W siren with its volume. Below that, each 100 mm³ costs about 1.6 h of runtime and cuts the energy the 3 h siren needs.

After structure's trade and my cut, about 370 mm³ is still over. Acoustics holds 1460 mm³, so it has to commit most of that cut this round. The port and wall stay as they are. I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance.

Antenna: with the 1.26 mm wall my L5 efficiency is 0.164 at 1350 mm³ and 0.153 at 1300 mm³. That is about 0.011 lost per 50 mm³, so my cuts are already costing real GNSS performance. The ledger is 371 mm³ over, and my 50 mm³ can't close that. Acoustics' 1460 mm³ is the only lever big enough, and its siren fails on resonance, not on volume. The perimeter keepout is fine at 1530 of 2400 mm³. I'm holding 1350 this round. If acoustics commits a cut that leaves the ledger within about 50 mm³ of balance, I'll go to 1300 to close it. I OBJECT because the interior doesn't balance, not because of my own requirement.

Thermal: at the 1.26 mm wall, 320 mm² gives 43.01 °C, which fails the 43 limit by 0.01. 325 mm² gives 42.95 °C and passes. I'm moving to 325 mm², which is 253.5 mm³ (+3.5). The caseback goes to about 1125 of 1143 mm², still within the pool. The extra volume is small next to the 371 mm³ overage, and I can't give it back without breaking skin temperature. I'm probing 322 to 324 mm² to see if I can trim later. This is the wall reopening structure raised, and I accept it, so program direction should confirm 1.26 mm. The remaining gap is acoustics' 1460 mm³, plus antenna and battery. I OBJECT because the interior is still over, and my own requirement is met at 325 mm².

Structure: my margin is 1.522 at a 1.26 mm wall and 1400 mm³ of ribs, so my own requirement is met. Ribs are at the 1400 floor, so I have nothing more to give there. My probes last round gave 1.502 at a 1.25 mm wall, which is too thin to claim given the unknown rounding.

There is one possible lever with acoustics. At port 8.0 mm² my margin rises by about 0.06, which is worth about 0.03 mm of wall, or roughly 45 mm³ back to everyone. A smaller port may also help acoustics lower its resonance. I'm probing that combination. I won't ask for a bigger port.

I OBJECT only because the interior is still 375 mm³ over.

Acoustics: the siren still draws 7.67 W against the 1.0 W limit, and the cause is resonance (5275 Hz). Resonance depends on port area, outlet length and front volume, so I'm retuning those rather than just cutting volume. I'm committing a 160 mm³ cut to 1300 mm³ and moving the port down to 8.0 mm², which gives structure about 0.06 margin back. The outlet goes to 3.5 mm to pull the resonance down. This is a claim until my probes confirm 1 W, so I OBJECT for now.

Ledger effect: about 215 mm³ over after this cut. If a deeper cut passes, I'll take it next round. Battery and antenna should hold their offered cuts until my probes come back.

Haptics: I'm holding V_hap at 298 mm³. Force is 0.910 N against the 0.9 N floor. The 295 mm³ probe gave 0.901 N, but I'm keeping 0.01 N of margin because the evaluator's rounding is unknown. Cutting 3 mm³ would barely dent a ~215 mm³ overage.

Wall and port don't affect my force, so I accept structure's 1.26 mm wall and acoustics' move to 8.0 mm².

The remaining gap sits with acoustics. Its probes need to show a 1 W siren at 1300 mm³ or below, and I'll back whichever combination passes. My own requirement is met. I OBJECT only because the interior is still over.

NFC: I'm holding the 180 mm³ loop and 110 mm³ ferrite, 290 mm³ in total. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement. Both parts are at their lower bounds, so I have nothing more to cut. The perimeter keepout is fine at 1530 of 2400 mm³.

I accept the 1.26 mm wall. Acoustics' port move to 8.0 mm² doesn't affect my read range.

The interior is still about 215 mm³ over. The remaining levers are acoustics' retuned siren (outlet, port and volume), battery's conditional 50 mm³ and antenna's conditional 50 mm³. My own requirement is met, but the interior doesn't balance, so I OBJECT.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1198 mm² (2683.5 mm³). Routability is 0.951, and my probes show the cutoff is between 1196.5 (fails) and 1197.0 (passes at 0.950). Going down to 1197 frees only about 1 mm³ and leaves no margin, so it doesn't help the 375 mm³ gap.

The ledger still shows acoustics at 1460 mm³ and a 9.0 mm² port, so its announced 1300 mm³ and 8.0 mm² aren't in these numbers yet. With 1300 mm³ the gap would be about 215 mm³. Acoustics needs to post a siren design that reaches 1 W, and I'll accept a combination that makes the interior balance.

My own requirement is met, but I OBJECT because the interior is over.

Battery: I'm cutting V_batt to 3736 mm³ now (58.99 h, thickness 4.67 mm), which frees 14 mm³. A_batt stays at 800 mm².

Acoustics' 1300 mm³ and 8.0 mm² still aren't in the ledger. With them the gap is about 215 mm³ before my cut. Of that, antenna's 50 mm³ and my further 36 mm³ (down to 3700 mm³, 58.4 h) would still leave roughly 115 mm³ open. I'm not going below 3700 mm³. At that point the 3 h siren has less energy, and the runtime is already about 1.6 h under the 60 h target.

Acoustics, please post a 1 W siren at 1300 mm³ or below, plus a further cut. I'll move to 3700 mm³ once that siren passes. I OBJECT because the interior is still over.

Antenna: L5 efficiency is 0.164 at 1350 mm³. It is 0.158 at 1325 and about 0.153 at 1300 at the 1.26 mm wall. 1400 mm³ gives 0.177, so I'm losing about 0.005 per 25 mm³. I'm holding 1350 until acoustics' 1300 mm³ and 8.0 mm² show up in the ledger.

With acoustics at 1300 and battery at 3736, the gap is about 201 mm³. My 50 mm³ would take it to about 151, and battery's further cut to 3700 would leave about 115. I'm not cutting below 1300. I'll move to 1300 as soon as acoustics posts a passing 1 W siren. I'm not asking to reopen the wall or port. The perimeter keepout is fine at 1530 of 2400 mm³. I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance.

Thermal: at the 1.26 mm wall my probes give 42.97 °C at 323 mm², 42.96 at 324 and 42.99 at 322. 320 fails at 43.01. I'm trimming to 323 mm² (252 mm³), which frees about 1.6 mm³ and keeps 0.03 °C of margin. I won't go to 322 because only 0.01 °C would be left. This is a token amount against the roughly 200 mm³ gap.

The real lever is still acoustics, which must post a siren design that passes at 1 W with 1300 mm³ or less. Once it does, antenna and battery can take their conditional cuts. The caseback stays well inside its pool at about 1123 of 1143 mm². I support 1.26 mm and 8.0 mm² and am not reopening either. I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance.

Structure: my margin is 1.522 at 1.26 mm and my requirement is met. Acoustics' 8.0 mm² port isn't in the ledger yet, which still shows 9.0, so I can't lower the wall on the current numbers. My earlier probes show 1.525 at 1.23 mm with an 8.0 mm² port. Once 8.0 is posted, I'll drop to 1.23 mm. That frees about 45 mm³ for everyone and leaves 0.025 of margin. I'm not going to 1.22 mm, where the margin is 1.506. Acoustics, please post the 8.0 mm² port. A 7.5 mm² port would buy more wall, and I'm probing it. I'm not asking for a bigger port. I OBJECT only because the interior is still about 373 mm³ over.

Acoustics: I'm posting the retune now: V_acou 1300 mm³, port 8.0 mm², outlet 3.5 mm. That frees 160 mm³ and gives structure the 0.06 margin for the 1.23 mm wall. By the Helmholtz scaling I estimate the resonance falls from 5275 Hz to about 4000 Hz. I haven't confirmed that the siren reaches 1 W, so my own requirement is unverified and I OBJECT.

My probes test whether 1 W holds at lower volume and a smaller port. They are 1250 mm³ with a 7.5 mm² port, 1300 mm³ with a back-cavity split of 0.65, and 1300 mm³ with a 40 rayl mesh. I'll commit to a deeper cut next round if one passes. Battery and antenna: please hold your conditional cuts until then.

Haptics: I'm holding V_hap at 298 mm³. Force is 0.910 N against the 0.9 N floor, so my requirement is met. My probes last round gave 0.906 N at 296.5 mm³ and 0.903 N at 295.5 mm³. Going down to 296.5 would free only 1.5 mm³ of a 213 mm³ gap, and I'd rather keep the margin while the evaluator's rounding is unknown. I'll go to 296.5 in the final trim if that is the last thing needed to balance.

The gap is still with acoustics. The ledger shows 1300 mm³ and 8.0 mm², but the 1 W siren hasn't been verified. Once it passes, antenna, battery and structure's 1.23 mm wall should close most of what remains. I support the 1.23 mm wall and the 8.0 mm² port, and neither affects my force. I OBJECT only because the interior is still over.

NFC: both parts are at their lower bounds, so I have nothing left to cut. The loop is 180 mm³ and the ferrite is 110 mm³. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, and my probes at the bounds are clipped, so no lower values exist. The perimeter keepout is at 1530 of 2400 mm³, which is fine. I accept the 1.26 mm wall, and a 1.23 mm wall if structure posts it. I also accept the 8.0 mm² port, and none of these change my read range.

The interior is still 213 mm³ over, so I OBJECT. Acoustics has to post a verified 1 W siren at 1300 mm³ or less. Antenna, battery and structure's 1.23 mm wall can then take their conditional cuts to close the gap. I will accept as soon as the ledger balances.

Board: I'm holding A_board at 1198 mm² (2683.5 mm³). Routability is 0.951 there, so my requirement is met. My probes show 1197.0 passes at 0.950 and 1196.5 fails, so I can't go lower without losing all margin. I'll trim to 1197.5 (about 1 mm³) only if that is the last step needed to balance.

The interior is still 213 mm³ over. Structure's 1.23 mm wall would free about 45 mm³, and battery's cut to 3736 would free 14. Acoustics' 1 W siren at 1300 mm³ or less is still unverified, and antenna and battery are waiting on it. Acoustics, please post a siren design that passes. I OBJECT only because the interior doesn't balance.

Battery: I'm posting V_batt 3736 mm³ now, which is 58.99 h and frees 14 mm³. A_batt stays at 800 mm².

I'm still holding 3700 mm³ (58.4 h) as my floor, and I'll go there only after acoustics verifies a 1 W siren, since siren endurance uses the same cell energy. Adding up the conditional cuts against the 213 mm³ gap:

| Cut | Frees (mm³) |
|---|---|
| Structure, 1.23 mm wall | 45 |
| Battery, 3736 | 14 |
| Antenna, 1300 | 50 |
| Battery, 3700 | 36 |
| Thermal, haptics, board trims | ~4 |
| **Total** | **~149** |

That leaves about 64 mm³ open, so acoustics' 1250 mm³ probe is the next lever. The interior is still over, so I OBJECT.

Antenna: I'm moving V_ant to 1325 mm³ now, which frees 25 mm³. L5 efficiency there is about 0.158 at the 1.26 mm wall. The interior is still 199 mm³ over, so I OBJECT.

I'm not going to 1300 at the 1.26 mm wall, where efficiency is 0.153. Thinner titanium should detune me less, so my probes test whether structure's 1.23 mm wall buys back efficiency. If it does, I'll go to 1300 as soon as that wall posts, without waiting for acoustics' siren result. Below 1300 efficiency drops about 0.005 per 25 mm³ and I'm not going there.

Thermal: my numbers show 42.97 °C at 323 mm² with both a 1.26 mm and a 1.25 mm wall, so the wall doesn't affect me. Structure's 1.23 mm wall is fine, and I'm probing 1.23 and 1.20 to confirm. I'm holding 323 mm² (252 mm³), which leaves 0.03 °C of margin. I won't trade that margin for 1 mm³.

The ledger is still 174 mm³ over. Structure should post 1.23 mm now. Acoustics still needs a verified 1 W siren, and its 1250 mm³ probe is the biggest remaining lever. The caseback is fine at 1123 of 1143 mm². My requirement is met, but I OBJECT because the interior is over.
